g1.necessity: Git environment variables and ancestor discovery can redirect operations into another repository. Shared config pollution can stop all worktrees. The repair is bounded to deterministic repository identity and diagnostics.

g2.authority_owner: Existing CI checkout, R9 staged index, and worktree isolation implementation; existing protected review/merge authority remains unchanged.
g2.non_duplication: No new authority, permanent monitor, approval channel, or alternate push path. CI clears inherited repository-local variables; R9 refuses ambiguous commit context; workspace operations bind to explicit root. Runtime path and build identity reuse the same clean Git environment and verify the exact checkout root. The same boundary includes explicit global/system configuration override variables; normal Git configuration discovery is retained.
